parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP instance to query. You can specify up to 50 EIP instance IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的EIP实例的ID。  最多支持输入50个EIP实例ID，实例ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the EIP to query. You can specify up to 50 EIP addresses separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的EIP的IP地址。  最多支持输入50个EIP的IP地址，IP地址之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: eip_address

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the cloud service
parameters.name: associated_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud service instance to associate. Valid values: 

EnsInstance: a VPC-type ENS instance.

SlbInstance: a load balancing instance
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定的云产品实例的类型，取值： 

EnsInstance：VPC类型的ENS实例。

SlbInstance：负载均衡实例
parameters.name: associated_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The status of the EIP. Valid values: Associating: being associated. Unassociating: being disassociated. InUse: allocated. Available: available
parameters.help_zh: EIP的状态，取值：  Associating：绑定中。 Unassociating：解绑中。 InUse：已分配。 Available：可用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the EIP is a standby EIP. Valid values:

true: standby.

false: not standby
parameters.help_zh:
是否备用弹性IP。取值：

true：备用。

false：非备用

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether ICMP echo reply is enabled. Valid values:

true (default): enabled.
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启ICMP代回。取值：

true（默认值）：开启。
false：不开启
parameters.name: icmp_reply_enabled

parameters.help_en: The array of ENS edge zone IDs. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number
